lines.beaver: 민호야, 요즘 얼굴이 안 좋아. 어디가 불편해?
lines.beaver_en: Minho, you don't look well lately. What's wrong?
lines.beaver_roman: Minhoya, yojeum eolguri an joa. Eodiga bulpyeonhae?
lines.learner: 요즘 목구멍이 아프고 침을 삼키기 힘들어.
lines.en: My throat hurts lately, and it's hard to swallow saliva.
lines.roman: Yojeum mokkumeongi apeugo chimeul samkigi himdeureo.

lines.beaver_en: Is it a cold? Is your breathing okay?
lines.learner: 숨 쉬는 건 괜찮은데 숨소리가 좀 거칠어.
lines.en: Breathing is okay, but it sounds a bit rough.
lines.roman: Sum swineun geon gwaenchaneunde sumssoriga jom geochireo.

lines.beaver_en: No fever? Your cheeks look red.
lines.learner: 열은 없는데 볼이 붓고 눈이 빨개.
lines.en: No fever, but my cheeks are swollen and my eyes are red.
lines.roman: Yeoreun eomneunde bori butgo nuni ppalgae.

lines.beaver_en: How about other parts? Your hands and feet?
lines.en: My fingertips and toes are cold. The tops of my feet are swollen too.

lines.beaver_en: Isn't that from walking a lot?
lines.learner: 응, 오른발 발톱이 아프고 종아리도 당겨.
lines.en: Yeah, my right toenail hurts and my calves feel tight.
lines.roman: Eung, oreunbal baltobi apeugo jongarido danggyeo.

lines.beaver_en: Is your heart okay? No pounding in your chest?
lines.learner: 심장이 빨리 뛰고 기운이 하나도 없어.
lines.en: My heart beats fast and I have no energy at all.
lines.roman: Simjangi ppalli ttwigo giuni hanado eopseo.

lines.beaver_en: Are you sleeping well? How's your head?
lines.learner: 몸은 피곤한데 잠이 잘 안 와.
lines.en: My body is tired, but I can't fall asleep.
lines.roman: Momeun pigonhande jami jal an wa.

lines.beaver: 그러다 쓰러지면 어떡해. 의식 잃은 적은 없지?
lines.beaver_en: What if you collapse? You haven't passed out, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureoda sseureojimyeon eotteokae. Uisik ireun jeogeun eopji?
lines.learner: 의식은 괜찮아. 그런데 주먹이 잘 안 쥐어져.
lines.en: I'm conscious, but I can't make a fist well.
lines.roman: Uisigeun gwaenchana. Geureonde jumeogi jal an jwieojyeo.

lines.en: It hurts around my navel. My whole body feels heavy.

lines.beaver: 몸속에 문제가 있을지도 몰라. 내일 병원 가자.
lines.beaver_en: Something may be wrong inside. Let's go to the hospital tomorrow.
lines.beaver_roman: Momssoge munjega isseuljido molla. Naeil byeongwon gaja.
lines.learner: 응, 내일 꼭 가 볼게. 고마워.
lines.en: Okay, I'll definitely go tomorrow. Thanks.
lines.roman: Eung, naeil kkok ga bolkke. Gomawo.
